objective: Verify that character moves according to input axes and updates animation states.
preconditions: Player object is active in scene.
expectedResult: Player moves in the targeted direction and returns to idle state when input stops.

gherkin.given: player is active in the game scene
gherkin.then: player character moves in the corresponding direction

objective: Verify player jumps when grounded and cannot double jump unless specified.
expectedResult: Player jumps on first press and airborne constraints are respected on second press.

gherkin.given: player is grounded on a surface
gherkin.then: player applies upward force and enters jump state

description: Process damage and update player life.
objective: Verify player health decreases when taking damage and triggers death event at 0.
expectedResult: Health value decreases appropriately and death event triggers when HP hits zero.

gherkin.given: player is alive with active health points
gherkin.when: player receives damage equal to current health
gherkin.then: health reaches zero and trigger death sequence

description: Pick up collectable item into inventory.
objective: Verify item is destroyed in world and added to inventory slot.
preconditions: Item pickup object exists in scene.
steps: Collide with or interact with item.
expectedResult: World item disappears and item icon appears inside inventory slot.

gherkin.when: player collides with the pickup object
gherkin.then: item is added to player inventory and removed from world

objective: Verify consuming item applies effect and updates quantity/stack.
preconditions: Player has at least one usable item in inventory.
expectedResult: Item effect is applied to player and inventory quantity decreases by 1.

gherkin.given: player has a health potion in inventory slot
gherkin.then: player health increases and potion stack count reduces

description: Interact with NPC or environmental object.
objective: Verify pressing interact key near object triggers interaction event or dialogue.
steps: Press interact key (e.g. E or F).
expectedResult: Dialogue UI opens or mechanism is activated.

gherkin.given: player is standing inside NPC interaction zone
gherkin.then: dialogue window opens displaying NPC text

objective: Verify weapon hitbox deals damage to enemy objects during attack state.
expectedResult: Attack animation plays, hit detection triggers, and enemy receives damage.

gherkin.given: enemy is in range of player attack
gherkin.then: enemy takes damage and plays hit flash/animation

objective: Verify enemy moves sequentially between patrol waypoints when target is absent.
preconditions: Player is not in detection zone.
steps: Observe enemy behavior without player intervention.
expectedResult: Enemy navigates continuously between waypoint positions.

gherkin.given: enemy is idle with patrol path assigned
gherkin.then: enemy moves along patrol waypoints continuously

description: Detect and chase player when within detection range.
objective: Verify enemy switches from Patrol to Chase state when player enters vision sphere.
steps: Move player into enemy vision/detection trigger.
expectedResult: Enemy stops patrol and begins moving directly toward player position.

gherkin.scenario: Enemy spots player and initiates chase
gherkin.then: enemy targets player and changes state to chase

objective: Verify clicking Play button loads the game gameplay scene.
expectedResult: Main menu unloads and first level scene loads successfully.

gherkin.given: player is on main menu screen
gherkin.then: scene manager loads primary game level

description: Toggle pause menu during active gameplay.
objective: Verify pressing Escape/Pause sets Time.timeScale to 0 and displays UI.
expectedResult: First press pauses time and shows menu; second press hides menu and unpauses time.

gherkin.given: game is running in active state
gherkin.then: time scale sets to zero and pause menu appears

objective: Verify score UI text updates immediately when score points are collected.
steps: Add points to player score via game event.
expectedResult: Score counter text updates to match new numerical total.

gherkin.scenario: Score increases after collecting point item
gherkin.then: HUD updates score text with new total

objective: Verify audio source plays corresponding SFX audio clip on jump trigger.
expectedResult: Jump sound clip plays through audio source.

gherkin.then: jump sound effect audio clip is played

description: Save game progress using PlayerPrefs or JSON.
objective: Verify player data persists when game is closed and reopened.
expectedResult: Loaded state reflects level 1 completion status accurately.

gherkin.when: game is restarted and load requested
gherkin.then: saved player state is restored successfully

objective: Verify camera position stays centered on or follows player transform smoothly.
preconditions: Camera follow target is assigned to player.
expectedResult: Camera position interpolates towards player position without jittering.

gherkin.given: camera target set to player transform
gherkin.then: camera updates position to maintain player in view
